prompt.project_info: Create a warm photorealistic UGC fashion portrait of an approved adult blonde woman reclining on a beige sectional in an upscale modern living room.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with bleached-blonde long messy-chic waves, center part, soft-glam makeup, feline eyeliner, nude-beige eyeshadow, clear gloss, and natural skin texture. She wears a black micro-ribbed bandeau crop top, high-waisted black silk-blend skirt with a left-side slit and ruched knot, layered gold chains, and a thin gold bracelet. She reclines with weight on the right armrest, right hand on the cushion, left hand relaxed on the upper thigh, and a soft direct gaze.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 portrait, relaxed three-quarter/full seated framing on a beige oversized sectional, subject eyes the focus, mirrored wall panels extending the room, kilim earth-tone pillows, minimalist kitchen cabinetry, stainless fridge, wooden dining set, and black pendant lights visible in reflection.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm 3000K ceiling track lights mixed with directional window daylight, soft contact shadows, minimal harsh edges, warm natural D65 color, and reflective highlights rendered gently in the mirrors.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic path-traced look, 35mm wide-angle lens, f/2.8, pin-sharp eyes, shallow depth of field, realistic hair strands, skin pores, ribbed fabric, silk drape, linen sofa, and subtle natural grain, 9:16 crop.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a warm photorealistic 9:16 lifestyle fashion portrait of an approved adult woman with bleached-blonde long messy-chic waves, a symmetrical center part, soft-glam makeup with sharp feline eyeliner, nude-beige eyeshadow, clear lip gloss, and natural pore-level skin texture. She reclines on a beige oversized linen sectional in an upscale modern living room, leaning her weight on the right armrest, right hand flattened on the sofa cushion, left hand relaxed on the upper thigh, and looking softly directly at the camera. She wears a black micro-ribbed bandeau crop top, high-waisted black silk-blend skirt with a left-side slit and ruched side knot, layered gold chains with small circular pendants, and a thin gold bracelet. Use eggshell warm-yellow walls, floor-to-ceiling mirrored panels, earth-tone kilim pillows, minimalist kitchen cabinetry, stainless fridge, wooden dining set, and black cylindrical pendant lights.
